notes.title: Update Now Available!
notes.content:
Greetings Wizards!




It’s been a month and a half since we launched in 1.0 and we’ve been hard at work addressing your feedback over the last six weeks. We released a small update at the end of June to address some of the issues you all were experiencing as you journey on your quest through the Trials, and we’re excited to share that we have a new patch available today!




This patch includes a wide variety of fixes to continue to improve your experience. You can check out the full patch notes below, but some highlights include updates for more stable online co-op, a fix to the Forgotten Knowledge achievement, some new narrative and worldbuilding additions, and much more!




Thank you so much for the support and feedback you’ve provided during both Early Access and in the weeks following the 1.0 launch. We hope you enjoy the updates!



Best of luck in the Trials,

-Wizard of Legend 2 Team




[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/de89f3b27a819c834f0589557ff51e0d0f855986.gif"]

Full Patch Notes: 



⚔️ Gameplay


- Fixed an issue where the player could become stuck after skipping the Serjik Tournament cutscene.



- Fixed a bug where the following Arcana did not work during the Hieronymus encounter: Electro Bind, Galvanizing Discharge, Flame Ward, and Tearing Whirlwind.



- Fixed the Forgotten Knowledge achievement (Players can now unlock it after finding 20 Variant Arcana.)

Note: Due to data sync limitations from Early Access, players using EA save files may need to start a new save slot to properly unlock certain achievements.



- Fixed a bug where players could respawn in empty space after revival.



- Fixed a bug where falling into a pit in Nox could cause the player to respawn at the start of the level and break progression.
 

- Fixed an issue where the player could get stuck in a pit if the respawn location was occupied by an enemy.



- Fixed an issue where the player did not fall when Jabbarah’s pit spawned beneath them, causing them to become stuck.



- Fixed an issue where, if all 10 relic slots were full, acquiring an 11th relic caused it to drop in an unreachable location.



- Fixed a bug preventing enemy spawns during the chaos ambush event in the desert biome.



- Fixed a bug where some Arcana sound effects persisted after defeating enemies with cutscene animations.



- Fixed an issue where the Soul Medallion relic failed to count kills made with charged signature Arcana.
 

- Fixed an issue where chaos enemies could become invisible if attacked during their teleport animation.



- Fixed a bug where repeatedly swapping two chaos Arcana in the Player Info Menu could cause them to enter a cooldown state with black icons, requiring re-casting to reset.



- Fixed a bug where chaos enemies could get stuck behind objects in certain areas of the map.
 

- Fixed a bug where the player model turned black if hit while casting Ultimate Assault Arcana.




🌐 Online Co-op


- Fixed a bug where the client would disconnect at the start of a run if the host went offline and then back online via the online menu before the client joined.



- Fixed an issue where the client player could spawn in an unknown location instead of the HUB upon joining the game.



- Fixed a bug where swapping Arcana in the Player Info Menu as a client could break cooldowns and render them unusable.



- Fixed a bug where the client player could see but not pick up enhanced Arcana from previous levels that appeared in boss or start rooms.



- Fixed a desynchronization issue where enemies appeared out of sync from the client’s perspective when the host was far away.



- Fixed a visual glitch where Hieronymus appeared to move in stutters from the client’s perspective.



- Fixed a bug where player details sometimes failed to load for client players.



- Fixed a bug where other players could interact with the portal while someone was speaking to the Nox NPC.




🎮 Local Co-op


- Fixed an issue where the second player could disconnect the third and fourth players using the exit button.



- Fixed contracts not functioning properly in local co-op.




🖥️ UI / UX


- Fixed an issue where, if the Player Info Menu was open at the time of death, the camera would shift to its previous position after revival.



- Edited the Pact of Blood description to better clarify its function.



- Fixed issues with the character selection screen text box.



- Fixed a bug where audio failed to load properly after restarting the game.



- Fixed an issue on Windows where the first mouse click was ignored after switching window focus.



✨ Gameplay Improvements


- Added an indicator to the Wind Elemental’s Ultimate phase to better present its attack pattern.



- Added a system to skip navmesh generation if it takes too long during level loading, preventing the game from getting stuck on the loading screen.




📖 Narrative & Worldbuilding

- Expanded narrative interactions for:
 

Shopkeepers in the Chaos Biome

Characters in the Hub after end-game

Nox’s Chaos Ambush scenes

notes.title: New Patch Live - Assorted Fixes and Minor Adjustments
notes.content:
This patch includes the following:


 Resolved a rare game crash while the player has the Chaotic Echoes dash arcana.
 Resolved an issue where the clients would get disconnected when the server went offline and then online again.
 Resolved an issue where if the shop menu was open for the client and the server chose to return to the HUB via the pause menu, the client would spawn into the void instead of the HUB.

notes.title: V1.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
V1.0 Patch Notes:


The game is now complete, and all biomes are in place. You can play from start to finish!
 
New Content & Features
New Biome: Explore the treacherous new Chaos biome, featuring its own Miniboss and the Final Chaos Boss.

New Bosses: Face off against the fearsome new Fire and Wind Elemental Bosses.

New Arcanas: Unleash the power of 12 new Chaos Arcanas.

New Medallion: Discover and utilize a brand new Medallion.

Unlockable Cosmetics: Acquire new cloak symbols by completing contracts.

Relic Availability: All relics are now available for purchase from Moulin in the Hub.




Balance & Gameplay Adjustments:

Arcana Tweaks: Many arcanas and their variants have received gameplay and balance tweaks and improvements.

Boss & Miniboss Balance: Significant balance changes applied to all Bosses and Minibosses, with a particular focus on multiplayer encounters.

Challenge Adjustments: Balanced Taffy, Wizard Challenge, and Champion Chests in both single and multiplayer modes.

Improved Bet Challenges: Bet Challenges have been refined for a better experience.

Serjik Appearance Rate: Serjik is now more likely to appear in his tournament for a fight.

General Polish: Implemented many small polishes and improvements to the overall gameplay and balance.




UI & Audio Improvements:

Element Selector: Added a tutorial video for each element in the element selection menu at the beginning of the game for clearer choices.

Charge Bar: Introduced a charge bar to make charge attacks more intuitive and visually clear.

Sound Effect Feedback: Added and improved many sound effect feedbacks throughout the game.



System & Resource Changes:

Resource Simplification: Removed the Chaos Core resource. All Nazradin runes can now be unlocked with Chromo.

Resource Caps: A cap has been set for both Chaos Gems and Chromo.


Bug Fixes
 
Gameplay:

Fixed a bug where players could leave the combat area in the jungle biome while enemies were still alive.

Fixed an issue where players could get stuck on shopkeepers by dashing into them.

Fixed a bug where players could skip a combat zone by pointing outside of it while casting the Heavenly Assault arcana.

Fixed a crash that occurred when changing keybindings with different keyboard language layouts.

Fixed an issue where some vases in the castle biome spawned in empty spaces.

Fixed a bug where dashing into an empty space in the Nox level could cause the player to respawn at the beginning of the level.

Fixed a rare issue that could cause the game to freeze when interacting with the Forgotten Arcana Variant or the Enhance Arcana Crystal.

Fixed a rare issue that prevented players from starting a new game.

Fixed a bug where the helping wizard in the Forest Guardian challenge wouldn't attack enemies until taking the first damage.

Fixed an issue where the helping wizard in the Forest Guardian challenge could be pushed out of the combat zone and couldn't return.

Fixed a bug where equipping a health item would play hit feedback.

Fixed an exploit where Inferno Barrage could be abused by dashing while casting it.

Fixed a bug where players could die from Bahador's projectile after his death.

Fixed an issue where killing an elemental boss with Shock Assault could cause the player to face the wrong direction.

Fixed a rare game crash during the Atlas cutscene.

Fixed a bug where opening the pause menu while falling into a pit would cause the player to get stuck in an empty space.

Fixed an issue where Serjik might disappear during his post-dialogues in the first encounter of the Serjik Tournament.

Fixed a bug where Jabbara pits didn't work properly if they spawned in the player's location.

Fixed an issue where Jabbara's phase change could be interrupted by the Freeze status effect.

Fixed some incorrectly placed invisible walls across all biomes.

Fixed a bug where pressing the space button would swap Nox shop items instead of buying the current item when the arrow on the UI was pressed.

Fixed an exploit where the Champion Chest and Forest Guardian could be damaged before the fight started while the player was out of range.

Fixed an issue where players could leave the combat zone after activating the teleport in the castle biome.

Fixed "Sparking Flame Breath" causing sparks from friendly projectiles.

Fixed a bug where dashing into an enemy burned by Searing Rush did not trigger an explosion.

Fixed an issue where closing the controlled disconnect pop-up while the game was paused would unpause the game while the UI is still open.

Fixed a bug where the desert snake could deal damage twice with a single ability if the player stood at the edge of the attack.



Online Co-op:

Fixed an issue where the jungle's explosive mushroom did not work properly if the server was far away.

Fixed a bug where the desert's snake dart did not work properly if the server was far away.

Fixed an online issue where selecting "Return To Hub" as the host while a client was interacting with a shop led to a showstopper on clients.

Fixed a rare issue where a client might spawn in the wrong location in the hub after accepting an invitation.

Fixed clients disconnecting from the session when starting the run if the host had gone offline at least once.

Fixed Inferno Barrage not behaving correctly on clients.

Fixed barriers sometimes remaining on clients with poor internet connections.

Fixed moving far away from the combat area in the Nox level as a spirit leading to unintentional post-process issues.

Fixed players getting stuck if they stood in a barrier location before its activation.

Fixed laggy spirit movement on clients.

Fixed spirits not having an icon on the map.

Fixed an issue where dashing into a pit and instantly walking back towards it could allow the client to walk on it.

Fixed bought arcana from Serjik as a client not saving correctly when the player left the session and played in solo mode.

Fixed player indicators not working correctly after cutscenes or revival.

Fixed some resource counts not displaying correctly on the Run Summary screen.

Fixed clients sometimes see unbreakable vases.

Fixed clients being unable to interact with the mirror while another player was using it.

Fixed the resources UI not updating while the player was in Spirit mode.

Fixed the aura around the Enhance Arcana Crystal Challenge and Chest Challenge, which did not turn red after activation on clients.

Fixed player fall animations not playing properly on other clients.

Fixed the Wizard Duel health bar, which sometimes does not disappear for the client after a battle with the wizard.

Fixed health crystal collisions sometimes remain on clients.

Fixed clients not seeing information about the automatically first selected arcana when opening the Player Info tab using a joystick.

Fixed clients sometimes see two wizards in the same room in the Jungle biome.



Local Co-op:

Fixed Healing Room items disappearing after a client interacted with the statue.

Fixed guest player's controller keybindings resetting each time.

Fixed all players spawning in the same spot after using a teleport in local co-op mode.

Fixed closing the teleportation map while standing in a teleport station, causing the interaction to disappear.




Relics:

Fixed Relic of Legend being incompletable if the player reached the maximum number of relics.

Fixed Mordeon’s Gem to count gold collected by all players instead of only the relic’s owner.

Fixed Spectral Hourglass only prevented death twice.

Fixed healing relics sometimes stop working after a while.

Fixed Gaia's Shovel not working on the client with the Impaling Drill Arcana.

Fixed Ring of Ouroboros not working properly.

Fixed signatures bar being able to charge while the player was carrying the "Sharpened Stylus" relic via Esme's upgrades.

Fixed the Tir's Blessing relic being abused by canceling the cast of Lightning Spear arcana with a dash.

Fixed Figure Skating Blades relic not working properly.

Fixed The Eagle Feathers relic not working correctly with the Spine of the Archimnagi and Sharpened Stylus relics.

Fixed dropping Armor of Golden Tears while carrying the Fall Medallion causing the player to heal constantly.

Fixed Sampling Needle not dropping health globs when the Elemental Wizards changed phase.

Contracts:

Fixed the "The Glacial Graveyard" contract description.

Fixed "The Arch Wizard Witch Hunt" contract reward's description.

Fixed "The Nox Sinister Secrets" contract being incompletable.

Fixed "Arcana Ascension" contract being incompletable.

Fixed "Arcane Arcana Adventure" contract being incompletable.

Fixed "The Tavern Brawl" contract not working for clients.

Fixed "Boss Dash Brawl" contract not working for clients.




Graphics:

Fixed unsupported screen resolutions being available in the video settings.

Fixed some cloaks having black spots in their textures.

Fixed texts going out of bounds in some dialogues.

Fixed some incorrect symbols in Simplified Chinese and Japanese languages.




...and more quality of life and stability improvements.

notes.title: Wizard of Legend 2 Leaves Early Access June 12th
notes.content:
Get ready to unleash your magical prowess and embark on an electrifying new journey in Wizard of Legend 2, launching into 1.0 worldwide on June 12, 2025. After being in Early Access since October 2024, the 1.0 version of Wizard of Legend 2 will come to PC, PlayStation, and Xbox adding new content like the Chaos Biome, Chaos minibosses, and a formidable Final Boss. Players can also master 12 new Chaos Arcana, discover 10 new relics, and take on fresh objectives with new contracts. With expanded multiplayer options for local and online co-op, the update builds on the fast-paced, spell-based combat, offering an even more vibrant, action-packed world.


The 1.0 update brings a wealth of gameplay enhancements that increase replayability and challenge. Players can now face the ultimate trial in the Chaos Biome, where they'll battle minibosses and the new Final Boss. With over 75 Arcana to master, including the Chaos Arcana, players can experiment with different elemental combinations to craft their unique playstyle.


The addition of achievements, new contracts, and customization options ensures that every playthrough feels fresh and rewarding. Whether teaming up with friends for 4-player co-op or facing the trials alone, Wizard of Legend 2 offers endless strategic possibilities. The update also includes numerous bug fixes, optimizations, and balance adjustments to make the game smoother and more polished than ever before.


Wizard of Legend 2 features added since Early Access:

 4-player Co-op: Team up with friends in seamless online or local multiplayer, supporting up to four players. Online and local co-op gameplay has been enhanced with better responsiveness for Arcana abilities, refined camera behavior, multiplayer boss HP adjustments, and smoother item selection to reduce accidental purchases, resulting in a more gratifying co-op experience.

 Chaos Biome and New Challenges: The addition of the Chaos Biome introduces fresh environments, new minibosses, and a formidable Final Boss, providing dynamic combat encounters and serving as the ultimate trial. 

 Master Elemental Arcana: Players can master the element of Chaos with 12 new Arcana, offering additional magical powers and new strategies to explore.

 New Contracts: Take on a brand new batch of objectives with new contracts, earning rewards as you progress.

 Sky Citadel Content Update: The Sky Citadel content update introduced a new biome with 12 new enemies, including the Royal Spear Knight miniboss and the King and Queen boss. Along with the return of Dash Arcana, including 15 Arcana options, two new NPCs, improved boss behaviors, updated dialogues and voice lines, enhanced customization, local co-op improvements, and numerous balance changes.

 Gameplay Improvements: Thanks to player feedback, the team has implemented several quality-of-life improvements since Early Access, including numerous fixes and tweaks to enhance gameplay, such as smoother local and online co-op, bug fixes for Arcana and Relic interactions, better boss behavior, and refined level designs. Adjustments also addressed UI issues, menu improvements, and balance changes to ensure a more polished and enjoyable experience.

 Expanded Language Support: Wizard of Legend 2 supports a wide array of languages including Brazilian Portuguese, Chinese, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Russian, Spanish, and Turkish, expanding accessibility for players worldwide.


Be sure to follow developer Dead Mage on Twitter, Facebook, and Instagram, as well as visit the official website. Join the community and begin your adventure to become the next Wizard of Legend!

notes.title: Update 0.6.3 is live now.
notes.content:
Wizard of Legend 2 - Update 0.6.3

Major Changes

 Improved multiplayer stability to prevent client freezes.
 Significantly improved the aim assist system.
 Improved the minimap and teleporter functionality.


Arcana

 Added missing sound effects for Magma Trap and Flare Rush.
 Fixed multiple Dash Arcana to function as intended when dashing over pits.
 Fixed a bug allowing some Dash Arcana to activate more than once in a single dash.
 Improved the descriptions for multiple Arcana to better explain and match their functionality.
 Fixed Concentrated Beam Variant to correctly burn nearby enemies.
 Resolved Slow Effect stacking in multiplayer.
 Fixed a bug where Ice Spear rotation would sometimes appear incorrectly.
 Fixed a bug where Heavenly Strikes VFX would sometimes stick to player hands.
 Fixed a bug where Blitz Charge Arcana VFX would stick to the player.
 Fixed the Whirl Dash Arcana VFX on clients.


Map

 Fixed a bug where some teleporters were not functioning for clients.
 Improved the navigation and selection of teleporters on the map.
 Fixed a bug where players would continue walking after interacting with teleporters.
 Reduced the likelihood of different sections of desert maps drawing over each other.
 Fixed a bug where bridges were not displayed on the map.
 Fixed a bug where some parts of the level, including their lighting, were not displayed on the map.
 Fixed a bug where specific map chunks would cause the minimap to disappear.


User Interface (UI)

 Fixed a bug where the wizard's health bar would not hide after the fight.
 Fixed a bug where the Wizard and Miniboss HUDs would overlap.
 Fixed a bug where the purchase sound would play when there were insufficient Chaos Gems to purchase an item in the wardrobe.
 Added feedback when players attempt to purchase items with insufficient currency.
 Fixed a bug where Arcana remained highlighted after quickly closing the player info screen.
 The "Choose" button is now only displayed for completed contracts.
 Fixed a bug where a relic icon appeared darkened in the Relic Trader.
 Fixed a bug where the UI for the "bet event" would display keyboard controls instead of gamepad controls when the second player interacted with it.
 Improved the UX of Nazradin Menu.
 Improved the UX of Mimi the relic bank.
 Improved Esme's UI to identify upgrades for which you don't have enough gold.


Gameplay/Combat

 Bosses can no longer become airborne while staggered.
 Fixed a bug where other players could be recognized as targets by the aim assist system.
 Champion Chest spells no longer destroy themselves after a boss defeat.
 Players are now invulnerable to Elemental boss attacks after defeating them.
 Fixed a bug where summoned enemies sometimes would not die after their summoner was defeated.
 Revive orbs now disappear if all players are revived.
 Fixed a bug where the player became uncontrollable when falling into a pit in the Jabarra level.
 Fixed the death animation after the player fell into a pit.
 Fixed a bug where the player lost avatar control after falling into a pit when the Pit Lord upgrade was active.
 Fixed a bug where players were unable to enter level portals.
 Fixed a bug where players were unable to dash after being revived in multiplayer.
 Fixed a game crash that occurred after dashing.


AI

 Fixed a bug where Bahadur would unexpectedly dash in multiplayer games.
 Fixed a bug where Jabarah's AI would break after receiving consecutive hits from players.
 Fixed a bug where companions could initiate combat before the player.
 Fixed a bug where Serjik's fireball would not deal damage to players.

notes.title: 4-Player Available Now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/162d77422a3bebe09778b9ff365c8ae24508db9c.jpg

Version 0.6.0 "4 Player Co-op"

Gameplay Improvements:

- Added the feature of playing while the map is opened.
- Greatly improved responsiveness of Basic, Signature, and Dash Arcana in online co-op.
- Improved local co-op camera behavior when a player is knocked down.
- Added a small delay to item selection in shops upon opening to prevent accidental purchases.
- The game now pauses if a controller disconnects in single-player and local co-op.
- The game no longer offers unrelated enhancements for Fueled Berserk.
- Bosses have generally lower HP in multiplayer.
- Improved female wizard head gear placement.
- The arcana info in the UI has been updated to show their arcana slot and improve readability.
- Added a feature that the game gets paused when minimized.

Bug Fixes

General:
- Fixed a bug where players could sometimes teleport out of the level.
- Fixed a bug where falling into pits could be interrupted by opening the player info menu.
- Fixed a bug where players could freeze after reviving or returning to the hub.
- Fixed a bug that sometimes the client player wouldn't receive the starting Chaos Gems from Serjik.
- Fixed a bug where healing item icons were incorrectly placed on the map.
- Fixed a bug where the evade text was missing.
- Fixed a bug that the volume setting wouldn't reset correctly in the settings menu.
- The "Reset to Default" settings option now only resets the current settings tab.
- Fixed some issues in the key binding menu.

Co-op (Local):
- Improved local co-op camera when another player is knocked down.
- Fixed a bug where simultaneous interaction with objects in local co-op could break the game.
- Fixed a bug where other players would teleport near the player interacting with menus in local co-op.
- Fixed a bug where the interaction wouldn't work if a player was already near shielded rewards in local co-op.
- Fixed a bug in local co-op where players' starting relics would reset to the first player's relic upon returning to the hub.
- Fixed a bug where the arcana enhancer and relic altars appeared disabled when only one player interacted with them in local co-op.

Co-op (Online):
- Fixed a bug that caused a crash when the run summary was shown while another player had the pause menu open in online co-op.
- Fixed a bug that the game wouldn't save for the client after the host chose to return to the main menu.
- Fixed a bug that, when a player left and rejoined the host in the same session, they were recognized as the 3rd player.

Arcana/Relics:
- Fixed a bug that the Zurvan's Crest effect remained on enemies after dropping the relic.
- Fixed a bug where players' signature arcana could be lost if they had both the Cursed Spectral Hourglass and Wizard Instruction Manual relics.
- Fixed a bug where some directions had priority over others in keyboard input.
- Fixed a bug where the Zurvan's Crest relic would stack in multiplayer.
- Fixed a bug where the variants for Blizzard and Perforating Jet wouldn't appear in the variant options.

Enemies/Bosses:
- Fixed a bug where the Golem chunk teleport wouldn't work before talking to the NPC wizard.
- Fixed positioning and teleport timing in boss intro sequences.
- Fixed a bug where some textures were missing in elemental bosses.
- Fixed a bug where traps wouldn't be disabled after a fight ended.
- Fixed a bug where some trap SFXs remained after a fight.
- Fixed a bug where Serjik wouldn't disappear at the end of the Serjik Tournament fight.
- Fixed a bug where there was an invisible wall on clients just before reaching Nazradin.
- Fixed a bug that Nazradin's negative runes would shift to incorrect slots.

Levels/Environment:
- Numerous polishes and fixes for Sky Citadel and Desert biome chunks to improve visual alignment with physics and remove invisible obstacles.
- Improved Castle biome map to remove extra lines and parts shown on the map.
- Fixed a problem where there was an invisible wall where the Sky Citadel keys were located.

UI/Menus:
- Improved notification messages when players are entering portals.
- Fixed some missing localization texts.
- The Nox shop UI has been updated to match other UIs.
- Improved the UX for the Arcana Enhancement menu.
- Fixed various bugs where the Arcana Enhancement menu showed incorrect upgrades when the Arcana had been enhanced through Esme.
- The Arcana Enhancer altars no longer require gold for enhancing an arcana.
- Fixed a bug that sometimes the Arcana Enhancer altar showed fewer choices.
- The enhancement altars in a single level no longer show the same enhancement choices.
- Fixed an issue where the hovered indicator remained on the last item hovered after closing and reopening the menu.
- Fixed a bug that the camera would zoom in if a player started a boss intro while others had the player info menu open.
- Fixed a crash on minimizing the game while on the run summary screen.

We're always interested in hearing your feedback! Join the conversation on Discord, or follow the game on X, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok.

notes.title: New patch is live - Version 0.5.3
notes.content:
Version 0.5.3 Update Notes

 Gold is now displayed in player HUDs and the updated shop UI for better visibility.
 Enhanced enemy attack signals for improved visibility and telegraphs.

 Earth boss ultimate is now easier to dodge.

 Multiple network optimizations for smoother gameplay.


User Interface (UI)

 Key rebinding confirmation now shows button icons instead of names.
 Added an option to reset settings to default.
 Improved UI polish and resolved text overflow issues.
 Fixed player info icons for PlayStation controllers.
 Updated arcana slot UI to accurately reflect locked status.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed Duel wizard not spawning if the location was inaccessible.
 Resolved contracts becoming non-functional if the player was revived.
 Fixed multiple items being highlighted in the arcana enhancer.
 Corrected ownership of the first outfit provided by the game.
 Fixed an exploit allowing infinite gold with Morideon's Necklace and relics increasing max HP.
 Addressed confirmation popups being canceled when clicking outside them.
 Enhanced arcana crystal offers now display proper icons, descriptions, and costs.
 Minor polishes and fixes in shopkeeper chunks.


Multiplayer Fixes

 Player ground indicator is now visible only for local players.
 Added new map icons for co-op players.
 Fixed issues with second player spawning outside the camera frame in local co-op.
 Resolved result screen not appearing if a player was revived with Spectral Hourglass relic.
 Fixed getting stuck in loading when a client logged out during the process.
 Addressed player ghosts spawning at the level start and fixed their rotation.
 Prevented castle spear miniboss from spawning if a player is outside the arena.
 Fixed client falling through the ground in tiny spirit levels.
 Resolved contracts being saved per language.
 Corrected run summary displaying incorrect relic and arcana information.
 Fixed interactables not registering when players were nearby.
 Updated player info to display medallion details and wizard names correctly in local co-op.
 Fixed snake trap sound not playing for client players.
 Corrected arcana and relic traders changing items upon multiple interactions.
 Addressed client accessories remaining in the server world after leaving the game.
 Fixed color not applying fully to male character capes in local co-op menu.
 Reduced net update intervals for characters, critters, and breakables.
 Fixed dialog control issue in local co-op, allowing all players to interact.

Thank You for Your Feedback!
Stay tuned for the next major content update very soon that will include the 4 player coop.

Your input helps us improve the game. Keep sharing your thoughts as we continue to enhance the experience. Happy gaming!

notes.title: Roguelike ARPG Wizard of Legend 2 adds new biome and bosses in major update
notes.content:
As Wizard of Legend 2 early access rolls on, developer Dead Mage has a hefty new update for its action roguelike. If you've been sitting on your hands waiting patiently for a new Hades 2 update, this Diablo-adjacent dungeon crawler is one to keep on your radar. It offers all manner of stylish and powerful Arcana, a blend of magical powers, attacks, and spells that combine the elements to unleash devastation upon your foes. The new Wizard of Legend 2 update is the first major expansion since its early access launch, and it's a big one.
Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Sky Citadel Content Update is Available Now!
notes.content:
✨ The Sky Citadel Biome
Explore a new environment reimagined with fresh twists. Inspired by the first game, this aerial fortress will push your skills to the limit with:

Unique Enemies
Air Castle Architecture
An Original Musical Score

Prepare for a breathtaking journey through the skies!

⚔️ New Enemies & Bosses
12 New Enemies
Face off against a host of formidable foes, including fan-favorites inspired by the first game.
New Miniboss: Royal Spear Knight
A powerful adversary with precision strikes—be ready to adapt your tactics!
New Final Boss: The King and Queen
The rulers of the Sky Citadel await. This epic battle will test your mastery of the skies and your arsenal of arcana.

💨 Dash Arcana Returns
Back by popular demand, Dash Arcana has arrived with 15 options to enhance your combat strategies!

Includes fan-favorite arcana
New additions for tactical depth and flair

Speed, evade, and strike with style!

🧙 New NPCs
Two new allies join the trials, offering fresh opportunities to power up and adapt your strategies. Find them and gain an edge!

🎨 Narrative & Voice Updates
We’ve refined the game’s narrative for greater immersion:

Run NPC Dialogues: Streamlined, enhanced, and featuring new voice lines to bring characters to life.
Voltran Thunder Ace: Fully re-recorded voice lines for a fresh, electrifying take on his persona.


🔥 Boss Behavioral Updates
To keep encounters exciting and challenging:

Elemental Bosses: Adjusted abilities and behaviors in later chapters to match your growing arsenal of arcana and relics.
Earth Boss Terrus: Completely reworked with new, earth-shattering abilities—your feedback helped us reimagine his fight!


🎨 Additional Features & Improvements

notes.title: The Sky Citadel Update: Our First Major Content Expansion
notes.content:
Greetings, Wizards!

The moment you've been waiting for has arrived—the first major content update for Wizard of Legend 2 will be here next week!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/330f8105a053f90a7e5995a46f6ff587b2cd449d.png

After several patches and minor updates that improved stability, performance, and added support for multiple languages, we’re excited to introduce The Sky Citadel Update—a major content expansion packed with new adventures, characters, and challenges.

Sky Citadel Biome
The Sky Citadel is a stunning new environment, brimming with challenges and surprises. Inspired by the first game, this aerial fortress is reimagined with fresh twists, including unique enemies, dazzling architecture, and an original musical score.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/de89f3b27a819c834f0589557ff51e0d0f855986.gif

12 New Enemies: Prepare to face adversaries, some inspired by fan-favorite foes from the first game.

Miniboss: Confront the Royal Spear Knight—a force to be reckoned with!

Final Bosses: Take on the Citadel’s rulers, the King and Queen, in an epic battle that will test your mastery of the skies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/2c0a02b16ba7addc19c5f05ce45cc4b86c945694.jpg

Boss Reworks and Behavioral Updates
To ensure every encounter feels thrilling:

Elemental Bosses: Adjusted abilities and behaviors in later chapters to match your growing arsenal of arcana and relics.

Earth Boss Terrus: Completely reworked with new, earth-shattering abilities to better embody the power of his element, following player feedback about his difficulty level.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/6560345091a3c98ed3eff02151ff2de25e6cf922.jpg

Dash Arcana Returns
The long-awaited Dash Arcana is back! Featuring 15 options—including fan favorites and brand-new additions—these arcana offer tactical depth and exciting ways to enhance your combat strategies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/af755881d41d4ff7ac888f35076e2d85f8e01466.gif

New NPCs
Two new allies join the trials, bringing fresh opportunities to power up and adapt your strategies.

Esme: An old-school painter who enhances your arcana cards for gold, letting you tailor your build during each run.

Dr. Song: A returning favorite who studies healing arcana. Donate cards to her research and earn powerful relics in return.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/c7eee71cbab5076f8c8cfefb56325ddfdb375c13.png
Narrative and Voice Updates
We've refined the game’s narrative to make it more engaging:

Run NPC Dialogues: Streamlined and enhanced with new voice lines to better develop characters and immerse you in the story.

Voltran Thunder Ace: Re-recorded voice lines for a fresh take on his electrifying persona.

Additional Features and Improvements
Customization: New options to perfect your wizard’s look.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/5e58406efe482c152456ddb96cfa96d19a0dad36.jpg

Local Co-op: Simplified menus and joining process for seamless multiplayer fun.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/a93b85b850a5b8c0c2a406cb8c729004bfa196a3.jpg

Quality-of-Life Enhancements: Numerous balance changes and improvements across the game.
This update is just the beginning! Check out the full patch notes for all the details, and as always, your feedback is invaluable. Let us know what you think of the new content and features.

Stay Magical, and see you in the Sky Citadel!

Wizard of Legend 2 is currently in development, so aspects of the gameplay previewed here might change before release—and Dead Mage is always interested in hearing your feedback! Join the conversation on Discord, or follow the game on X, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok.

notes.title: What to Expect for Wizard of Legend 2!
notes.content:
Dear Wizards,

As we journey together through the world of Wizard of Legend 2, we’re excited to share a glimpse of what’s to come during our Early Access period! This roadmap is designed to give you an idea of the future updates and improvements we have planned while still allowing us the flexibility to adapt based on your feedback and input.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/97dfe5da87ed50a39674180fe68348f771c265a6.jpg

Here’s what you can expect to see throughout Early Access (please note these features are listed in no particular order):


1. New Biomes: Castle and the Final Biome

Prepare to explore entirely new environments! We’re working on introducing two distinct biomes—Castle and the Final Biome—each offering:

 Unique environments: Visually stunning environments filled with new obstacles to overcome.
 Unique enemies: Face fresh challenges as you battle foes never before seen in the trials.
 Epic boss fights: Each biome will culminate in an intense boss battle that will test your skills.

2. Two New Elemental Bosses

We’re adding even more depth to the elemental challenges with two new elemental adversaries that will bring their distinct Arcana to the trials offering fresh challenges and rewards


 Fire Boss: Brace yourself for an inferno of fiery attacks and scorching strategies.
 Wind Boss: A master of the skies, this boss will push your mastery of Arcana to new heights.

3. Expanded Narrative and Story

The trials have always been more than just tests of power. As we continue to expand the Wizard of Legend 2 world, we’ll introduce more profound lore and story elements. This will include:
The story of other wizards in the trials: Discover more about the characters you meet, their motivations, and the greater mysteries behind the trials.

4. More Arcana, Variants and Enhancements

Expect an even more extensive arsenal of Arcana spells to discover and wield, adding layers of strategy and gameplay variety. Enhance your favorite Arcana with new upgrades, allowing you to fine-tune and power up your spells to suit your preferred strategy. Experiment with new elemental powers and craft unique combinations that suit your combat style.

5. More Relics

As the trials progress, we’ll introduce more powerful relics that offer buffs, unique abilities, and new ways to tailor your wizard's abilities. Keep an eye out for relics that can dramatically alter the course of your run!

6. 4-Player Co-op

One of the most requested features is coming! We’re working on expanding the co-op experience from two players to four-player co-op, letting you and three friends team up for even more chaotic and exciting multiplayer action.

8. More Medallions

We’re also expanding the collection of Medallions—items that have distinct gameplay effects and can change the way you approach the trials. Look out for new medallions that can give your wizard the edge in battle.

9. More Contracts

Expect more Contracts to be added, which are special objectives requested by members of the hub. Managed by Aletheia, these contracts will allow you to delve deeper into the lore of the world while earning unique rewards.

10. More Customization Options

Show off your unique style! We’re adding more cosmetic customization options, including masks, robes, and symbols. Customize your wizard’s appearance to stand out as you take on the trials.

11. More Charms and Difficulty Settings

For wizards seeking greater challenges, we're introducing an expanded range of Charms and Difficulty Settings. These features will allow you to customize your gameplay experience and push your skills to the limit:

 New Charms: Unlock powerful modifiers that alter gameplay mechanics, enemy behavior, or environmental factors, creating fresh and demanding scenarios.
 Adjustable Difficulty Levels: Fine-tune the intensity of your trials with more granular difficulty options, catering to both newcomers and seasoned wizards.


These additions will provide endless replayability and ensure that even the most experienced wizards will find new ways to test their mastery of the arcane arts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/29baac8e564c0dbc34270d90f2ae2beb5e372e5c.jpg

Throughout Early Access, we’ll refine the core gameplay and balance combat for you to experiment with. Your feedback plays a crucial role in helping us shape the future of Wizard of Legend 2, so keep sharing your thoughts as you take on the trials!

Thank you for being part of this journey. We can’t wait to see how you harness the power of the elements!

Stay magical,
The Wizard of Legend 2 Team

notes.title: Almost Legendary – When Ice and Lightning Strike
notes.content:
In Wizard of Legend 2, would-be legends from across Lanova assemble to test their skills in the trials of the Floating Lands. Each brings their unique strategies, elemental proclivities, and mix of powerful Arcana to prove to the Wizard Council they’re the best of the best of the best. Some will skirt success. Most will fail spectacularly.
 
In this first installment of Almost Legendary, we chronicle the tale and tactics of one such contender who could have become a legend…but instead will go down in history as just another pretender.

Chilling Shock

Wizard of Origin: Maestro, the superconductor
Cause of Defeat: Mis-timed double dash into the void

This particularly devious wizard built his fate around the Lighting Conductor Relic, which massively increases lighting damage on frozen enemies. (If you see it as a starting choice in your run, get ready to bring the pain!) Maestro then chose the Ice Blast Signature Arcana, which freezes enemies in a small cone in front of you on a brief cooldown. Since he planned to battle up close, he chose Lightning Spinner, which works like a fast-hitting electric flail, as his Basic Arcana. (Unleash it with abandon and watch your frozen foes sizzle to a crisp.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/8845c6d47271c44f70319f333135be69e1ccf2f5.gif

In keeping with the theme of “up close and personal,” the Signature Arcana Galvanizing Discharge buffets enemies around you with a thunderous blast and knocks them back, though any other Lighting-based Standard Arcana will be effective if you choose to try this yourself.

Two Relics gave this build that extra oomph he sought: Battery of Tanaris, which grants yet another boost to your Lightning damage, and Arctic Gloves, which keeps enemies frozen longer. If you manage to get this setup rolling yourself, you’ll almost feel sorry for the inhabitants of the Labyrinth. Just learn from Maestro, and don’t let all that lightning prevent you from spotting the pits.

Wizard’s Arsenal
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/9dd45a55c7b2a272db8ecaf171fe891480cea4ae.png

Developer’s Notes: “Ice Blast is a versatile Standard Arcana that can benefit all kinds of builds. In this instance, its confined area-of-effect synergizes with the other close-range Arcana, but it would be just as useful as a disengagement tool in builds where you want to stay at longer range. When fully charged, it becomes immensely useful as a means to reset the battlefield.  –Game Director Aryan Bina

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/9e46f067a5e1ae02c9003e39259a4ae9b9f5220a.gif

Wizard of Legend 2 is currently in development, so aspects of the gameplay previewed here might change before release—and Dead Mage is always interested in hearing your feedback! Join the conversation on Discord, or follow the game on X, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok.

notes.title: Arcane Knowledge 4: A legendary tale
notes.content:
In the third Arcane Knowledge mini-series entry, we explored developer Dead Mage’s roots and what the studio's earlier game Children of Morta taught the team about storytelling. For our fourth and final entry in this mini-series, let’s talk a little more about how…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/f8a563557b6ec73ac3bb16b5b03b64a24e6bea58.png

Story matters

As is evident from the studio’s previous work, Dead Mage clearly takes storytelling seriously. The rogue-lite genre presents both distinct challenges and opportunities, and the team is hard at work implementing a narrative approach that leverages its strengths—and doubles-down on what makes Wizard of Legend unique.

“We’ve gone all-in on the world of Lanova,” says game director Aryan Bina. “Fans of the original will recognize some old faces,” such as the shadowy purveyor of cursed relics, Nox, “and we’re introducing many more who we hope that they’ll love just as much.”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/c223df83a824fce8a2f01aa2d883057da0f805ba.png
Wizard of Legend 2 weaves a tale from an earlier era of Lanova, centered around a cast of characters who each have different reasons for being at Van Eyckrous mansion. Head mage Hieronymus wants to discover someone worthy of becoming the next Wizard of Legend. The powerful sorcerer Serjik can’t resist the siren’s song of a good challenge. Madam Moulin, Nazradin, and Aletheia each have their own tales to discover.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/51b8a8366b76241b26e84331be5fe59e69ec122c.jpg

“In the spirit of the game’s fast pace, these characters will be the primary vehicles for storytelling—they’ll move the plot along and give you insights about the world as you play, and when you talk to them in the hub. This being a rogue-lite game that you can play for many hours, you should expect lots of story in here, as well as some unexpected twists.”

As for what awaits those who seek to become a legend, the wizards of Lanova will have to find out for themselves...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/f02419a4a23cc0b302c9bdff8158ca540bafe752.png

Following up the original Wizard of Legend is a charge that Dead Mage doesn’t take lightly. The game was a certified hit, with a community of passionate players across multiple platforms—and Dead Mage is committed to honoring that for the sequel. 

“We’re all huge fans of the original Wizard of Legend,” says Bina. “For us, success means staying true to what made it great, and giving fans more of that. Feedback from the community is a huge help for us in achieving this.”

To be part of that conversation and stay up to date on Wizard of Legend 2, wishlist the game here on Steam, and join us on X, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and Discord.

Want to know more? Check out these other articles:
Legendary Wizarding 101
Arcane Knowledge 1
Arcane Knowledge 2
Arcane Knowledge 3

notes.title: Arcane Knowledge 3: Learning from a legacy
notes.content:
In our previous Arcane Knowledge mini-series entry, you learned more about how death is a great teacher (but meta-progression upgrades are pretty great too). Today, we’ll explore another excellent teacher—your own past experiences.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/e94a923667dab9aa4c627edb6784d7202ea5f7a3.png

Children of Morta’s DNA runs deep through Wizard of Legend 2

Prior to working on Wizard of Legend 2, Dead Mage created Children of Morta, an acclaimed rogue-lite action RPG lauded for its carefully crafted and expansive story, stellar gameplay, and engrossing progression loop. Now the team is thrilled to have the spirited, Arcana-infused world of Lanova as their canvas.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/f60209836aaaf2342d534d6ef7a7e450e778a10d.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/f6b266169e3d3368c31b12c71b3d9a3fb009223b.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/4128e3f8f4bcbc546e589e697ba1c0e2b1426510.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/3c51faa0de8c3767942f091c3b1f95da070489c3.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/620c6d66304aaa596430d097db5f68acf8c83d81.jpg

“Children of Morta taught us a ton about integrating story into a rogue-lite game,” says game director Aryan Bina. “We're building on what we learned, but with a greater emphasis on procedural storytelling in Wizard of Legend 2. Our goal is to preserve the original game’s fast pace, so we’ve put a lot of effort into making sure we can effectively convey the story through in-game commentary from the main characters.”

Cooperative multiplayer came as a post-release update to Children of Morta, and adding such a substantial feature to an already established game was a challenge. Dead Mage took that experience to heart for Wizard of Legend 2, which will launch with local and online co-op supporting up to four players. 

“We’re designing Wizard of Legend 2 with multiplayer in mind from the outset,” Bina says. “From building strong network architecture, to working out all sorts of gameplay-related details—stuff like multiplayer game balance, visibility and readability—these are all things that we’ve been lucky enough to be able to address as soon as we started the project. Our intention is to make Wizard of Legend 2 as fun and balanced in groups as it is playing solo.”

Up next…about that story

Read the previous Arcane Knowledge entry

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/dbadd0dadbb8f84245d2d65d68393b758c7abaea.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2193540/Wizard_of_Legend_2/

notes.title: Arcane Knowledge 2: Facing the inevitable
notes.content:
In our previous Arcane Knowledge mini-series entry, you learned more about Arcana and the enhancements you can apply to them. Wise wizards learn to master the combinations available to them. But most wizards aren’t wise, and they will learn today’s lesson the hard way…

Death is inevitable (but progression is permanent)

There’s no way around it: you will die a lot while playing Wizard of Legend 2. Ascending to the pinnacle of arcane prestige is not supposed to be easy! But the good news is that you—well, technically, the endless parade of ambitious wizards you’ll guide through the trials of the Floating Lands—will only get better after each death.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/a3651b062360541daa3f75b203f10f0de0c30675.png

One of the first things you’ll notice upon visiting Van Eyckrous mansion, the game’s hub area, is a wondrous magical apparatus with a seemingly insatiable appetite for the Chaos Gems you’ll collect during your runs. The more of them you feed it, the more permanent upgrades it will bestow upon you to aid in future runs.

“One primary upgrade available through the apparatus is the Double Dash," says game director Aryan Bina, calling out a power the team expects will be an early must-pick for many players. “This allows wizards to execute a second dash immediately after the first, which is particularly useful for traversing pits.” The Floating Lands are littered with pits, and being able to dash over them in dual succession is both liberating and life-saving.

Aspirants with a flair for fashion will also be thrilled to learn that robes are making a return from the original Wizard of Legend. Switching up your wardrobe is not only good for morale, but each robe also confers powerful gameplay benefits. “Some robes are designed specifically to assist players less experienced in this genre,” says Bina, and will be helpful for beginner wizards who may just be coming to grips with the rogue-lite hazards of the Floating Lands.

Coming up next…learning from a legacy

notes.title: Arcane Knowledge 1: Magic possibilities of Wizard of Legend 2
notes.content:
Bold and ambitious mages, whose eyes are set on wizardly prestige—welcome to Arcane Knowledge, a mini-series of mini-articles exploring a few fascinating facets of the fast-paced rogue-lite’s development, from its renewed emphasis on character-driven storytelling to its expanded options for build-crafting.

What secrets shall we scry?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/5ae1bae50f0abe9d7c7db68ec53cc09938222d8b.png

More magic = more better

Wielding the elements in all their destructive majesty is what the Wizard of Legend experience is all about—and this is precisely what Dead Mage is aiming to build on in Wizard of Legend 2. The goal is to give you the widest possible palette of magical tools to experiment with as you assemble your ideal arsenal of Arcana, the spells you wield during your runs.

As we discussed in our Legendary Wizarding 101 preview, wizards will start each run by choosing a loadout of Basic, Signature, and Standard Arcana from six elemental schools, with opportunities to acquire even more during their trials—but your Arcana will continue to evolve as you get further into your run.

“A big priority for us was to add a variety of enhancements that players can apply to each Arcana,” says Aryan Bina, game director of Wizard of Legend 2. “We want to offer players interesting choices for every Arcana. We’re hoping that this variety will encourage players to experiment and find clever and unexpected applications for their favorites.”

Bina conjures up Dragon Dive, a ranged Arcana, as an example of how enhancements can change your play. “It summons tunneling dragons to repel enemies, but its enhancements offer different strategies. Dragon Ride allows the player to teleport at the end of the dragons, facilitating rapid repositioning and enemy confusion. For those who prefer a combination of melee and ranged combat, you could choose the Returning Dragon enhancement, which performs a distant attack and pulls enemies closer for melee Arcana attacks.”

Factor in Arcana upgrades (which are applied independently from enhancements) as well as Relics (powerful ability-altering items that are returning from from the original Wizard of Legend) and you have a dizzying array of arcane build-crafting ahead of you. 

And of course, Wizard of Legend veterans should expect some all-new Arcana in the magical mix. Some of Dead Mage’s favorites include Earthclap, a thunderous area-of-effect ability that’s good for grouping-up enemies for further comboing, and Monk Strike, a fast-hitting close-range attack that’ll surely become a standby for melee mages.

Coming up next…facing the inevitable

notes.title: Legendary Wizarding 101: Chronicling Wizard of Legend 2’s Trials
notes.content:
Dodging a rival wizard’s torrent of fire. Picking up the Cursed Relic that turns the tide against that accursed golem. Fleeting victory! Embarrassing, pit-based defeat. 

When a would-be Wizard of Legend bets their life to claim the Chalice of Immortality, the only thing certain is uncertainty. But that doesn’t mean you can’t be prepared for the chaos that awaits in developer Dead Mage’s upcoming action-packed rogue-lite dungeon crawler.

Today, let’s delve into what a typical solo trial might look like for the brave, foolish, magical contenders of Wizard of Legend 2…

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2193540/Wizard_of_Legend_2/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/4c4ed185fc7979494129e090e5cf8d381db2f28d.png

Legends of Lanova

In an era long before the events of the original Wizard of Legend, a rare solar eclipse heralds the return of one of Lanova’s most ancient traditions: the legendary Trials, in which wizards from across the realm vie for their shot at life everlasting.

Only one wizard at a time can live with this immortal boon, an honor that currently belongs to a decadent, reclusive master of the arcane arts called Hieronymus. Together with his Wizard Council—the wise and disciplined Madam Moulin, the gravity-tending geomancer Nazradin, and the powerful and headstrong Serjik—they will test these ambitious young challengers to the Chalice, and find out whether any of them are worthy of becoming a legend. They certainly have their doubts.

Before the Storm

Each trial begins with you choosing 1 of 3 random wizards to take on the upcoming trial from beginning to end. Each contender has a particular penchant or power granted by their starting Relic, such as a watery shield that deflects projectiles, or an affinity for Dragon Arcana. Maybe you’ll choose a favorite you’re familiar with. Maybe you’ll choose something outside your comfort zone. Just don’t get too attached to your sorcerous new friend.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/f1d0c5da63a57f32de847bf974f77b097e44c570.png

Before each wizard ventures into the Floating Lands (the gauntlet where Hieronymus hosts the Trials), you’ll first have a chance to explore the grand grounds of Van Eyckrous mansion, a hub of social and story activity where you’ll make some critical decisions for your run.

Here, you might chat with fellow wizard NPCs to hear about their brilliant (ahem) combat plans, engage Serjik or Hieronymus for sage advice or savage mockery, or strike up a conversation about the meaning of existence with some enchanted cleaning supplies. In this liminal space, the story advances between trials, as you learn more about the personalities, histories, secrets, and motivations that drive Wizard of Legend 2’s eccentric arcane assemblage.

Van Eyckrous mansion also plays host to a mystical Apparatus tended to by a young woman named Aletheia, Madam Moulin’s niece, conscripted to a life of monotonous maintenance due to her lack of magical talent. Wise wizards would do well to get on Aletheia’s good side, because the Apparatus could hold the key to ultimate success.

When a wizard feeds Chaos Gems into this machine, it grants permanent upgrades to the player—for example, making it so passing through portals rejuvenates health, or increasing the odds of discovering enhancements during your trials. These upgrades put the “-lite” in this rogue-lite, as they persist between each run; meaning when your current wizard falls in combat, the next wizards in line will be able to benefit from these upgrades, too.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/ff5594f7b25446a63341998b92bb50a97445032a.png

Arcana Overwhelming!

Fire. Earth. Water. Air. Lightning. Chaos. Arcana are the source of every wizard’s power. The potential combinations are infinitely tantalizing. The opportunities for experimentation are as vast as the void. Before each trial begins, your wizard will select a loadout of three starting Arcana to use on their run, choosing from any of the six magical schools.

To start, you’ll pick one Basic Arcana (a workhorse cantrip you can cast as often as you like), one Signature Arcana (a more powerful ability; it also charges up a bar as you use it, eventually unleashing a mega-destructive ultimate form), and one Standard Arcana (a potent spell with a longer cooldown).

If you want all area-of-effect Fire Arcana, go for it. If you see what happens when you mix Water and Lighting, it’s your funeral. Want to try a trio of melee Arcana? Just the longest-range spells you can find? Want to try immortalizing your build as a meme? It’s up to you…just keep in mind that you’ll have opportunities to add two more Arcana to your arsenal during your trial, which could completely change your tactics and survival odds. A good wizard knows how to improvise.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/d2682c55e9b0b64569def1ac8efa41a0a152e00b.png

The Trial Begins

Once you’ve selected your initial Arcana loadout, it’s time to pass through the portal into the Floating Lands to see what gleeful carnage the council has concocted to test you. Every wizard begins their trial in the same place—an enchanted, but not exactly enchanting, jungle—but individual paths soon diverge, as chambers, portals, monsters, and challenging events are reconfigured between each run according to the council’s whims and Nazradin’s geomantic talents.

What might a wizard encounter, you wonder? Here’s just a sample of the Floating Lands’ myriad challenges and boons…


 A chamber full of monstrous flora and fauna that must be defeated in order to bring down a magical barrier.
 The mysterious Nox, an eerily familiar merchant who’ll offer you a choice of powerful, trial-changing, probably cursed Relics to use on your run.
 A raucous, gladiatorial clash with wizard council member Serjik…and considering your health after the contest, it’s a bit unclear whether he’s helping you or hindering you.
 A rival NPC wizard specializing in Earth magic—defeat her, and perhaps she’ll drop one of her own Arcana to add to your arsenal for the remainder of your run.
 An enchanted chest that tries to kill you. Oooh, that’s bad. But there’s an Arcana held within. That’s good! The Arcana is a terrible mismatch for your current loadout. That’s bad. But you can transmute the Arcana into gold to purchase a useful Relic later on. That’s good! The Relic is also cursed. That’s…bad? (You can go now.)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126579/30f0528cfad39515aff53886ea01c354f9f0da4f.png

At the end of each realm of the Floating Lands, every wizard must face off against its powerful boss, drawing upon all of their Arcana skill, dodging prowess, and dwindling health pool to advance to the next realm. Each realm has its own new environment, challenges, monsters, and nefarious ways to ruin a wizard’s day. 

But one wizard’s demise is the next wizard’s opportunity! And when you die, the cycle begins anew. Only this time, your skill has increased. You can dodge that golem’s attack with 96.3% proficiency. You’ve amassed more Chaos Gems to feed to Aletheia’s Apparatus, giving you an edge that your unlucky predecessor didn’t have. And you’ve got an awesome idea for a frost-themed build inspired by that blue wizard bastard who turned you into a block of ice….

Perhaps this time you’ll become…the Wizard of Legend 2!

[hr][/hr]
Wizard of Legend 2 is currently in development, and Dead Mage is constantly iterating, testing, and gathering feedback—the gameplay and features discussed here are subject to change, and Dead Mage would love to hear what you think.

For more articles and posts like these and to be part of the conversation, follow Wizard of Legend 2 on X, Facebook, and Instagram, and join the community on Discord!
